question: Which water body lies between Southern Europe and North Africa and accounts for about 0.7% of the global ocean area?
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Mediterranean Sea**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• The Mediterranean Sea lies between S**outhern Europe and North Africa and accounts for about 0.7% of the global ocean area**.
 
• It stretches from the **Atlantic Ocean on the west to Asia on the east and separates Europe from Africa**.
 
• It is connected to the **Atlantic Ocean through the strait of Gibraltar**.
 
• A study says that around **220,000 merchant vessels of more than 100 tonnes cross the Mediterranean Sea each year covering about one-third of the world's total merchant shipping**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• It is surrounded by **22 different countries**.
 
• It is also called the incubator of Western civilization.

 
 

 **Caspian Sea**
 The largest lake in the world 

 lies to the east of the C**aucasus Mountains and to the west of the vast steppe of Central Asia**.
 
 

 **Black Sea**
 It is located in the s**outheastern extremity of Europe **bordered by Ukraine to the north, Russia to the northeast, 

 G**eorgia to the east, Turkey to the south, and Bulgaria and Romania to the west.**
 
 

 **Adriatic Sea**
 The Adriatic Sea was **named after an ancient port, Adria, now Northern Italy**. It extends from the clear waters of the Mediterranean Sea and is **noted for its warm temperatures and calm currents**.
